crossRefs.note: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.
He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
Your mouth is like the best wine, that goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding through the lips of those who are…
In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice…
“Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk…
The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a…
But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
